meta.title: ClipsFlow — AI clips with burned-in subtitles
meta.description: Turn any episode or video into ready-to-post subtitled clips for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. Burned-in captions, vertical format, no app to install.

home.title: Turn your videos into ready-to-post subtitled clips
home.subtitle: ClipsFlow cuts your episodes into viral Shorts, Reels and TikTok clips — burned-in captions in 15 styles, vertical format, MP4 + VTT download. No editing app needed.
home.feature_dub_desc: Word-by-word animated captions in 15 styles, custom colors, fonts and positions.
home.feature_clips_desc: Shorts, Reels and TikTok clips with burned-in subtitles in 15 styles.
home.feature_consent_desc: 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 — pick a preset, generate, download MP4 + VTT.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Clips
onboarding.subtitle: Create your first subtitled clip in 3 steps — under 60 seconds.
onboarding.step1_body: Upload audio/video (max 500 MB), paste a direct HTTPS URL, or reuse an existing episode.
onboarding.step2_body: 12 presets and 15 caption styles built for TikTok, Shorts, Reels, LinkedIn, podcasts.
onboarding.step3_body: Burned-in captions, vertical format, direct MP4 + VTT download.

errors.no_speech_detected: No speech detected in this media. Subtitles require an audio track with dialogue. Your quota has been refunded.
errors.source_too_large: Source file is too large (500 MB max). Try a lower bitrate, smaller resolution, or shorter segment. Your quota has been refunded.
errors.invalid_source_url: The source URL is invalid or points to a restricted location. Use an HTTPS URL hosted on a public CDN or Supabase Storage. Your quota has been refunded.
